_README: claude-jig settings. The hooks below wire the three portable engines: guardrails.js (pre-write blocking/warning), post-edit-check.js (post-write typecheck/lint/build), and session-start.js (read-only orientation — prints the pack status + recommended next step at session start so anyone knows what to do; fail-open, never blocks). The permission allow/deny lists are a conservative starting point — widen `allow` to match your toolchain (the bootstrap command will suggest entries from your repo). NOTE: `permissions.defaultMode` is set to `plan`, so sessions start in plan mode — remove that key if you don't want it. If this project already had a settings.json, the installer left it untouched and these settings landed as settings.pack.json; merge the `hooks` block in (or run /go or /bootstrap-claude-pack) or the hooks stay dormant. Project-specific tuning lives in .claude/guardrails.rules.json and .claude/workspaces.json, not here.
